name: gdelt-mcp-server
description: Search and analyze global news coverage and US TV transcripts via the GDELT Project APIs.

gdelt_base_url.title: GDELT Base URL
gdelt_base_url.description: Override the base URL for the GDELT DOC and TV APIs.

gdelt_request_delay_ms.title: GDELT Request Delay (ms)
gdelt_request_delay_ms.description: Minimum milliseconds between GDELT requests, enforcing the 1 req/5s rate limit.

gdelt_request_timeout_ms.title: GDELT Request Timeout (ms)
gdelt_request_timeout_ms.description: Deadline in milliseconds for a single GDELT request; the whole call, retries included, is bounded at twice this value.
